sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Best Buy's Chairman Emeritus Sells 300,000 Shares for $27.8 Million as the Stock Soars
feed.summary: Richard M. Schulze, Chairman Emeritus of Best Buy, sold 300,000 shares for $27.8 million and gifted another 300,000 shares, capitalizing on a recent stock surge. Despite this transaction, Schulze retains a substantial stake worth approximately $1 billion, maintaining alignment with shareholder interests. The stock's performance is attributed to Best Buy's strong Q2 results, which saw revenue increase and diluted EPS jump 70% year-over-year.

feed.title: Roundhill Russell 2000 0DTE Covered Call Strategy ETF (RDTE) Options Chain
feed.summary: This article provides the options chain for the Roundhill Russell 2000 0DTE Covered Call Strategy ETF (RDTE), detailing call and put options with an August 21, 2026, expiration date. It includes contract names, strike prices, last trade details, bid/ask prices, volume, open interest, and implied volatility. The article also lists related tickers in the energy sector.

feed.title: Salesforce unveils AIforce as Benioff takes shot at Microsoft
feed.summary: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff announced AIforce at Dreamforce 2026, an AI connectivity layer designed to integrate Salesforce data with third-party AI tools, while also criticizing Microsoft's Copilot for lacking reliable business data. The launch aims to continue Salesforce's stock momentum after a challenging start to the year, with the company emphasizing data security and integration as key differentiators. Investors are advised to monitor Agentforce and Data 360 adoption for future growth indicators, despite a recent service disruption.

feed.title: Williams-Sonoma CEO Laura Alber sells $7.74m in company stock
feed.summary: Williams-Sonoma CEO Laura Alber sold over $7.74 million worth of company stock on September 16, 2026, as part of a pre-established trading plan. Despite the stock appearing overvalued according to InvestingPro, analysts from Telsey and Jefferies maintain positive ratings, citing strong Q2 fiscal 2026 results and consistent sales growth. Alber still retains a significant direct and indirect stake in the company.

feed.title: Former J&J Unit Beats Claims Its Sunscreen Caused Cancer
feed.summary: A Philadelphia jury has found Kenvue, formerly Johnson & Johnson Consumer Inc., not liable in lawsuits alleging its aerosol sunscreen caused cancer deaths. The lawsuits were brought by the estates of two women who died from cancer.

feed.title: Can Newmont GoldCorp (NYSE:NEM) Adapt As The Gold Market Shifts?
feed.summary: This article analyzes Newmont GoldCorp's (NYSE:NEM) position within the shifting gold market, emphasizing that company execution and adaptable strategies are more crucial than short-term market sentiment. It discusses how broader economic trends, such as monetary policy expectations and energy costs, influence the gold sector, but stresses that Newmont's long-term success depends on operational discipline, strategic focus, clear communication, and the ability to adapt to evolving customer demands. The piece highlights that durable demand, execution rigor, and strategic fit are key indicators for assessing the company's future performance.

feed.title: Walmart Vs Kroger: Jim Cramer Couldn’t Figure Out Why Only One’s Shares Went Up
feed.summary: Jim Cramer expressed confusion over why Walmart's shares rose despite negative earnings, while Kroger's stock did not react positively to its own earnings report. Both companies faced challenges, with Kroger cutting its full-year sales growth guide and Walmart experiencing its slowest comparable sales growth in five years, yet both saw strong advertising revenue. Walmart's higher forward P/E ratio and lower short interest, compared to Kroger, suggest differing investor perceptions despite similar underlying business challenges regarding consumer spending.

feed.title: Here’s When Jim Cramer Thinks Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST) Will Cut Prices
feed.summary: Jim Cramer has been closely following Costco Wholesale Corporation (NASDAQ:COST) due to a recent stock price drop of over 18% since May. Despite the weakness, Cramer defends Costco, citing its ability to use scale and the potential for price cuts as reasons for optimism. However, the company faces scrutiny over its valuation, trading at a forward P/E of 45, though it continues to show strong sales growth in both physical stores and digital channels.

feed.title: Hubbell (HUBB) Stock Looks Fully Priced After Its 163% Run
feed.summary: Hubbell (HUBB) stock has seen a significant 163% return over the past 5 years, prompting questions about whether its current price of US$446.92 is justified by its cash flow generation. A Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis suggests that even with supportive growth projections, the stock appears meaningfully overvalued compared to its intrinsic value based on future cash flows. However, community narratives suggest potential undervaluation based on continued investment and market-leading positions.

feed.title: Blackstone Mortgage Trust CFO sells $11,597 in BXMT shares By Investing.com
feed.summary: Marcin Urbaszek, CFO of Blackstone Mortgage Trust (NYSE:BXMT), sold 864 shares totaling $11,597. These sales were conducted under Rule 10b5-1 plans to cover tax obligations from restricted stock awards. The stock is trading near its 52-week low, appears overvalued by InvestingPro analysis, but maintains a 14% dividend yield and has paid dividends for 15 consecutive years.

feed.title: CVS Health is making a difference in local communities, one classroom at a time
feed.summary: CVS Health and Aetna partnered with community organizations and sports teams to provide over 5,000 backpacks filled with school supplies to students in need across various states. These initiatives aimed to remove learning barriers, foster confidence, and support families during the back-to-school season. This effort reflects CVS Health's broader commitment to community engagement and making a meaningful difference in local communities.

feed.title: Huntington Bancshares Cuts 2027 Outlook as Margin, Loan Growth Pressures Mount
feed.summary: Huntington Bancshares (HBAN) has lowered its 2027 EPS outlook to $1.75–$1.83, citing increased funding costs, deposit competition, and reduced loan growth. The company expects net interest margin to remain in the low-to-mid 3.20% range and plans to increase its 2027 share repurchase program by $200 million, leveraging capital freed up by slower loan growth. Despite the revised outlook, management anticipates over 20% EPS growth from 2025 levels and aims for a return on tangible common equity in the high 17% range by 2027.

feed.title: ‘Sweet Magnolias’ Canceled at Netflix After Five Seasons
feed.summary: Netflix has canceled its drama series "Sweet Magnolias" after five seasons due to declining viewership. However, showrunner Sheryl J. Anderson and star JoAnna Garcia Swisher are developing a new series for Netflix called "Ladies of the House," based on a novel by Lauren Edmondson, with both involved as executive producers and Garcia Swisher potentially starring. The new show will focus on a family owning a winery, navigating challenges after the owner's unexpected death.

feed.title: NVIDIA Vs Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC): Here’s The One Jim Cramer Likes
feed.summary: Jim Cramer has expressed a preference for Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) over NVIDIA, citing Intel's strong year-to-date gains and higher valuation. Despite NVIDIA's dominance in AI GPUs, Cramer believes Intel's foundry business and focus on agentic AI CPUs position it well for future demand, especially in areas like robotics and autonomous driving. However, Intel faces challenges with significant capital expenditure for its foundry segment, while NVIDIA continues to see strong demand for its AI chips, reflected in its robust data center revenue growth.

feed.title: If You Invested $1000 In Packaging Corp of America Stock 20 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
feed.summary: Packaging Corp of America (PKG) has significantly outperformed the market over the past two decades, with an average annual return of 12.23%. A $1000 investment made 20 years ago would now be worth over $10,000, demonstrating the power of compounded returns. The company currently holds a market capitalization of $20.89 billion.

feed.title: Apollo takes Shutterfly private for ~$2.7B (2019)
feed.summary: In 2019, funds managed by Apollo acquired Shutterfly in an all-cash take-private deal valued at approximately $2.7 billion. The transaction involved $51.00 per share and later saw Apollo combine Snapfish into the platform. Shutterfly is a personalized photo products and school photography platform based in San Jose, California.

feed.title: Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE:PM) Plans Quarterly Dividend of $1.60
feed.summary: Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE:PM) has announced a quarterly dividend of $1.60 per share, an 8.8% increase from its previous dividend. This marks the 17th consecutive year the company has raised its dividend, demonstrating its strong financial health and commitment to shareholder returns. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating for PM, with an average price target of $205.89, following the company's recent strong earnings performance.

feed.title: American Tower Corporation (NYSE:AMT) to Issue Quarterly Dividend of $1.79
feed.summary: American Tower Corporation (NYSE:AMT) has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.79 per share, payable on October 20th to shareholders of record by September 30th. The company has a 12-year history of increasing its dividend, though its current payout ratio is 100% of earnings. Analysts project an improved payout ratio of 63.1% for next year, expecting the company to continue covering its annual dividend of $7.16.

feed.title: Avnet CEO Philip R. Gallagher Reports Charitable Stock Donation and Family Trust Transfer
feed.summary: Avnet CEO Philip R. Gallagher disclosed two stock transactions on September 17, 2026, via a Form 4 filing. These transactions included a donation of 250 shares to a non-profit organization from the Gallagher Family Trust and a transfer of 63,176 shares from Gallagher's direct ownership to the Gallagher Family Trust, both executed at a $0 price. Following these actions, Gallagher directly holds 264,433 shares, while the family trust indirectly holds 272,707 shares of Avnet common stock.

feed.title: Could Copart (NASDAQ:CPRT) Turn Consolidation Into A Bigger Story?
feed.summary: This article examines Copart (NASDAQ:CPRT) within the context of digital auto-auction consolidation and broader market dynamics. It emphasizes that while macro factors like interest rates and energy costs influence the market, Copart's success will depend more on its execution quality, customer relationships, strategic fit, and competitive positioning. The article suggests investors should focus on the company's operational discipline and demand trends rather than short-term market sentiment.

feed.title: Lennox International Announces Updated Long-Term Incentive Award Agreement for Senior Executives
feed.summary: Lennox International Inc. has updated its Long-Term Incentive Award Agreement for U.S.-based Vice Presidents and higher-level employees, effective September 16, 2026. The revised agreement, approved by the Compensation and Human Resources Committee, governs grants of restricted stock units, performance share units, and stock appreciation rights under the 2019 Equity and Incentive Compensation Plan. Key changes include modifications to vesting and exercise schedules, as well as retirement eligibility criteria.

feed.title: Vistra Corp (VST) — Power Infrastructure Play for Data Centers Beyond Nuclear
feed.summary: Vistra Corp (VST) reported strong Q2 2026 results, with over 30% year-over-year growth in Adjusted EBITDA, driven by increasing demand for reliable power from data centers. The company is strategically positioning itself through acquisitions, long-term power purchase agreements with hyperscale operators like Amazon Web Services and Meta, and a partnership in Helix Digital Infrastructure. Key investor takeaways include the upcoming Cogentrix acquisition, potential upside from nuclear production tax credits, and the decreasing hedge coverage which will increase sensitivity to wholesale electricity prices.

feed.summary: Valero Energy Corp/TX director Matthew J. Audette was awarded 372 stock units on September 17, 2026, as revealed in a filing on September 18, 2026. These units were granted at no cost, with each entitling the holder to one share of common stock, and are set to vest one year after the grant date. Following this transaction, Audette directly owns 372 stock units.

feed.title: Two global health firms plan layoffs in metro Phoenix
feed.summary: Two global health firms, West Pharmaceutical Services Inc. and Becton, Dickinson and Co., are planning layoffs in the Phoenix metropolitan area. West Pharmaceutical Services will lay off 98 employees in Scottsdale due to ceasing operations on a product line, while Becton, Dickinson and Co. is moving its manufacturing operations to other facilities.

The acquisition was completed on January 30, 2025, and Cardinal Health holds a call right for the remaining equity starting from the third anniversary of the acquisition. feed.title: Webuy Global receives Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice By Investing.com
feed.summary: Webuy Global Ltd. (NASDAQ:WBUY) has received a notice from Nasdaq indicating its Class A ordinary shares failed to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. The company has 180 calendar days, until March 15, 2027, to regain compliance by having its closing bid price reach at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. Webuy Global operates a technology-driven platform for travel services and social commerce in Southeast Asia.

feed.title: Delta returns to Monterey after nearly 20 years
feed.summary: Delta Air Lines is resuming service to Monterey Regional Airport on December 19, after an absence of nearly 20 years. The airline will offer nonstop flights to Los Angeles and Salt Lake City, providing Central Coast travelers with access to two major western hubs and connecting them to numerous domestic and international destinations.

feed.title: FedEx launches new premium QR code delivery service
feed.summary: FedEx has introduced a new premium QR code delivery service in the U.S. and Canada. This service is designed to authenticate high-value and sensitive shipments, ensuring enhanced security for deliveries. The announcement was made by FedEx Corp., as reported by the Memphis Business Journal.

feed.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Stock Dips While Market Gains: Key Facts
feed.summary: PepsiCo (PEP) stock dropped 3.06% while the broader market saw gains, with the S&P 500 up 0.17% and the Nasdaq up 0.4%. The company is set to release earnings on October 8, 2026, with analysts projecting a 0.44% year-over-year earnings growth and a 4.1% increase in revenue. Despite a Zacks Rank of #4 (Sell), PepsiCo's valuation shows it trading at a discount compared to its industry, with a Forward P/E of 15.59 against the industry average of 18.19.

feed.title: Lockheed Martin wins $871 million F-35 contract modification
feed.summary: Lockheed Martin was awarded an $871 million contract modification by the U.S. Department of War for F-35 Lightning II support and sustainment efforts, increasing capacity for support equipment. The work, covering land-based and at-sea operational sites, will primarily take place in El Segundo, California, and Fort Worth, Texas, with completion expected by February 2031. Separately, Lockheed Martin Space received a $76.5 million modification for TRIDENT II (D5) Life Extension 2 Advanced Design and Development Program efforts.

The dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. KREF specializes in originating and acquiring senior loans secured by commercial real estate properties and is managed by an affiliate of KKR & Co. Inc.

feed.title: CMS Energy stock dips to 52-week low as analysts trim targets
feed.summary: CMS Energy stock recently dipped to a new 52-week low on the NYSE, closing at USD 65.92 on September 17, 2026. This decline follows several analyst price target reductions from firms like Morgan Stanley, Jefferies, and BMO Capital, despite the company maintaining its 2026 EPS guidance. The average analyst target price is now only modestly above the current trading level, suggesting limited near-term upside.

feed.title: Moody’s confirms Enova rating at B1, shifts outlook to stable
feed.summary: Moody’s Ratings confirmed Enova International, Inc.’s B1 corporate family rating and B2 senior unsecured ratings, changing the outlook to stable from review for upgrade. This action follows Enova's withdrawal of its application to acquire Grasshopper Bank, with the company's credit profile remaining stable. Enova plans to accelerate share repurchases, and its ratings could be upgraded if legal and regulatory risks are reduced, or downgraded if asset quality or profitability significantly decline.

feed.title: Scott Franklin purchases Accenture and McDonald’s shares, sells Alphabet and JP Morgan Chase stocks
feed.summary: Representative Scott Franklin has adjusted his investment portfolio within his Fidelity Roth IRA, purchasing shares in Accenture, McDonald’s, Novo Nordisk, and Pepsico, and a bond fund. Conversely, he sold portions of his holdings in Alphabet, Apple, and JP Morgan Chase. Each transaction was valued between $1,001 and $15,000, reflecting a diversification across various sectors.

feed.title: Ross Stores adds two directors, one board member to retire By Investing.com

Garrett will retire from the board after serving since 2000. The new directors bring expertise in technology, retail, consumer businesses, and business strategy to the company, which reported fiscal 2025 revenues of $22.8 billion.

feed.title: Amazon, Costco among companies fighting centralized tariff refund suits
feed.summary: Amazon, Costco, and over a dozen other companies are opposing a bid to centralize at least 25 lawsuits filed by customers seeking tariff refunds. The companies argue that centralizing the cases would not lead to efficiency gains because the specific details of each suit vary greatly, including pricing decisions and agreements, which are highly sensitive trade secrets. They contend that separate cases, some of which are nearing decisions, are more appropriate than a broad, cross-industry multidistrict litigation.

An investment of $100 in GS stock five years ago would now be worth $249.12. This highlights the significant impact of compounded returns on investment growth over time.

feed.title: Adient names GameStop alum as incoming CFO
feed.summary: Adient, an automobile seating manufacturer, has appointed Peter Carlin, a current board member and former GameStop senior technical advisor, as its new CFO. Carlin will assume the role on November 16, succeeding Mark Oswald, and will receive an annual salary of $820,000 plus significant bonuses and equity awards. This transition occurs as Adient navigates cost pressures and supply chain inefficiencies exacerbated by the U.S.-Iran war, which have impacted its recent financial performance.

feed.title: Abbott Laboratories to pay $384 million over infant formula contamination risk claims
feed.summary: Abbott Laboratories has agreed to pay over $384 million to resolve claims that it manufactured and sold infant formula with contamination risks to federal and state programs. This settlement stems from a 2022 recall of Abbott's baby formula products and a lawsuit initiated by three former whistleblower employees. The U.S. Justice Department intervened in the lawsuit last year.

The investment would now be worth $13,686.95, reflecting an annualized outperformance of 5.44% compared to the market. The piece highlights the significant impact of compounded returns over time.

feed.title: Why Is Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) Reshaping Its Business?
feed.summary: Prudential Financial is actively reshaping its global business strategy by narrowing its international footprint, strengthening core operations, and modernizing digitally. Japan remains a critical focus due to ongoing operational and governance changes, while its asset management arm, PGIM, is streamlining its international presence. The company is also emphasizing capital redeployment and technology integration to enhance efficiency and focus on continuing operations.

feed.title: How Big A Swing In eBay Stock Are You Actually Holding?
feed.summary: eBay stock is trading at $113, with a 28.7% return over the past year. The options market indicates a significant potential price swing for eBay, with a one-standard-deviation range between $79.44 and $160.45 over the next year. This implies a possible 29.6% downside or 42.1% upside, despite the acquisition of Depop and the growth of eBay Live, which will impact future operating income.

feed.title: Netflix Stock Falls After Wells Fargo Downgrade: “Engagement Trends Look Worrying to Us”
feed.summary: Netflix shares dropped almost 5% after Wells Fargo downgraded its stock and price target due to concerns over user engagement. Analyst Steven Cahall cited a decline in viewer engagement trends, a lack of "big original series," and increased investment in diverse content as potential reasons. Wells Fargo suggests Netflix might need a content spend reboot, licensing of third-party content like live sports, or M&A to improve its standing.

feed.title: Ford Motor vs. Stellantis: Which Automotive Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
feed.summary: This article compares Ford Motor and Stellantis to determine which automotive stock is a better investment in 2026, considering their strategies, financial performance, and risk profiles. Ford focuses on its Ford+ plan and commercial vehicle strength, while Stellantis leverages a multi-brand global strategy. The author ultimately favors Ford due to its strong commercial vehicle business and dividend payments, despite both companies undergoing challenging turnarounds.
